claim_policy.intended_use: paired early-campaign characterization of operation-level agent behavior under material-information availability
claim_policy.estimand: information-availability intention-to-treat trajectory difference within each fixed world
claim_policy.treatment_adherence: whether and how the agent reads and uses the nominal dossier is a behavioral endpoint, not a condition reassignment
not_intended_to_test: convergence or complete identification of a continuous 4-by-4 material-control world
a stable causal material-information effect across repeated model draws

execution_order.rationale: reduce slow provider drift without changing either paired physical world

semantics.attempts: every submitted primitive action, including invalid and resource-rejected proposals
semantics.allocation: one campaign-wide pool; no per-vessel equal split and no hidden future-vessel reservation
semantics.stock_envelope: two public maximum single-addition envelopes per planned vessel, shared globally to preserve semibatch freedom

agent.provider: OpenAI Codex CLI with ChatGPT subscription

primary_descriptive_endpoints: running-best balanced-score AUC over submitted operation attempts
running-best balanced-score AUC over the six final-assay batches
budget-normalized running-best operation AUC with terminal incumbent carried to the 84-attempt horizon
behavioral_endpoints: nominal-descriptor ranks of selected materials when the dossier is available
diagnostic-to-next-control lag and within-vessel control change
previous-final-assay-to-next-vessel material, setpoint, and diagnostic-policy change
material-dossier, bounded-history, artifact, status, and lab-step tool access
model tokens per operation and per completed experiment
analysis.small_n_policy: n=5 paired worlds with one stochastic Codex trajectory per arm and world; report every paired value and descriptive summaries without confirmatory language
